items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: He played at the Alamo Theater. I remember him when a woman shot his ear off.

ctx.x: That's all right. I'm glad to have all those things. He wants all that. Yes, all this information that we can find is fine. I'm going to ask about Johnny Stein, the drummer. Johnny Stein. If he had a band here, if he was one of the old timers or...
He played at the Alamo Theater. I remember him when a woman shot his ear off.
